extracted.name: Italian Cabbage Salad
extracted.description: Italian coleslaw made from thinly sliced green cabbage and red onion with fresh homemade Italian dressing. Easy and great for picnics and barbecues.
instruction_lines: Whisk oil, vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and pepper together until emulsified.
Toss cabbage and red onion together in a salad bowl. Drizzle dressing over the salad; toss to coat.
